_doc: Single registry of the secret formats minted by the VX apps and libraries. Read by secretFormats.ts (typed view) (trace sanitizer, path redaction, mcp-access), by template/scripts/lib/validation-logs.mjs (leak scan of the logs) and by template/scripts/gitleaks-config.mjs (the gitleaks rules of every project). A new prefixed secret is added HERE, in the same change as the code that mints it; nothing else lists app prefixes. `source` = where the format is minted (repository, file). `minEntropy` = Shannon entropy (bits per character, the gitleaks measure, prefix included) below which a match is a placeholder, set under the minimum of 300,000 random draws (base64url 43: 4.15, base62 32: 3.74, hex 64: 3.39); 0 = no filter. `leftBoundary`: the match must not follow a letter, a digit or `_` (an escaped `\n`, `\r`, `\t` still counts as a boundary), for a prefix that also occurs inside identifiers. A deliberately fake value written in clear (spec, doc, fixture) carries one of `fakeMarkers` right after the prefix (and after the OAuth marker), e.g. `tk_FAKE…`: the generated gitleaks allowlist accepts exactly that, by value, never by path.

oauth.description: mcp-access OAuth access token (at_), refresh token (rt_) and client secret (cs_, also the secret of a companion or a confidential DCR client), after the app key prefix

formats.description: ChainTradingDataAPI public API key (api-access, sold to third parties; also accepted by its MCP server)
formats.source: vx-private nest/api-access/helpers/apiKeyCrypto.ts (keyPrefix + 32 random bytes in hex); ChainTradingDataAPI back/src/modules/public-api/publicApiKeyPrefix.ts

formats.description: ChainTradingDataAPI mcp-access credential (native format of mcp-access under the ctd_ prefix)
TradeKong MCP access token (mcp-access credential, real money with the trade scope)
TradeKong order preview token (single use, 2 minutes, handed to the companion and presented back to submit the order)
Maestro service key (mcp-access credential: private works, recognition, artifact delivery)
FleetForge Gateway key (mcp-access credential reading, later checking and running playbooks on, a production fleet)
PapangWorkspace mcp-access credential (prefix reserved, no MCP code yet)

AgentHub API key (the only form AgentHub mints; also its mcp-access key prefix, hence OAuth tokens). A hand-chosen BOOTSTRAP_API_KEY value (any 8+ printable characters, still accepted by AGENTHUB_KEY_FORMAT, minted by no code) is caught by the assignment rule of AgentHub's .gitleaks.local.toml
AgentHub terminal share link token (the token is the URL)
AgentHub hub federation enrollment token (single use, 1 to 60 minutes)
AgentHub public issue intake token of a deployed app
AgentHub notification webhook signing secret (same prefix as Stripe and Svix signing secrets)
Step-up proof (single use, bound to one approval)

formats.app: vx-private llm-proxy (llm-proxy and the apps linking it)

identifiers.description: Public client_id of an mcp-access companion: an identifier, NOT a secret (its secret is <keyPrefix>cs_…, see oauth)
Public client_id of a dynamically registered OAuth client: an identifier, NOT a secret
